sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Tool: Automated Case Generation via Classification (ACGA) Purpose The Automated Case Generation via Classification (ACGA) tool is the primary execution engine for record formalization. It transforms analyzed intent into a structured, trackable case within the system of record. By leveraging high-fidelity classification data, it ensures that every case is initiated with the exact technical parameters required for automated routing and fulfillment.
Data Prerequisites Identity & Status Validation: Successful execution of the Customer Look-Up and Disruption Service Case Lookup tools.
Input Parameters Interaction Sys Id (interaction): The Interaction Record SysID used as the foundational anchor to maintain a 1:1 audit trail between the conversation and the case.
Table Name (target_table): --> Source: Output from Step 6.1 (Specialized Case Classification). --> Definition: The backend name of the ServiceNow table (e.g., sn_bom_treasury_wire_service) where the record will be created. This allows for dynamic record retrieval and creation.
System Definition Sys ID (sys_definition_id): --> Source: Output from Step .1 (Specialized Case Classification). --> Definition: The unique GUID from the System Definition table that identifies the specific configuration or metadata record linked to this disruption.
Summary (summary): A concise, high-impact headline (max 80 characters). Directive: Define the primary blocking issue so a human agent can assess urgency at a glance.
Description (description): A technical overview of the core issue, synthesized from the inbound request and classification findings.
Work Notes (work_notes): An internal-facing audit summary documenting the interaction history to ensure a seamless hand-off to the resolving agent.
Action & Logic Record Instantiation: The tool executes a direct system call to generate the case record within the specified Table Name.
Precise Field Injection: It strictly populates the Business Activity and metadata fields. The logic enforces a "no-variation" policy on system IDs to ensure post-creation routing engines trigger correctly.
Contextual Documentation: It synthesizes the Summary and Description to provide immediate operational clarity, eliminating the need for the resolving agent to perform redundant analysis.
Key Output New Case Reference Number: The unique system identifier for the newly instantiated record, confirming successful entry into the fulfillment workflow.
